clue.text: Chat lines?

parts.note: read as telephone services for talking, but the lines meant are printed ones in a newspaper carrying chat about celebrities

explanation.walkthrough: 'Chat lines' suggests premium-rate phone services; the lines are instead newspaper columns of tittle-tattle.
explanation.definitionFit: Newspaper features devoted to rumour and tittle-tattle are lines of print full of chatter about people.

clue.text: Coaching without a supply of Italian food

indicators.note: supply here is the adverb meaning in a supple, flexible way, so the letters are bent into a new order once the a is taken away

explanation.surface: A coach is going without provisions of Italian food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' tells you the letter A comes out of COACHING, leaving COCHING, and 'supply' (read as the adverb from supple, not the noun) rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: These are small potato dumplings, a staple of Italian cooking.

clue.text: Establishing the background

definitions.meaning: putting in place or fixing, as in fixing a date
the scene or surroundings against which a story takes place

explanation.definitionFit: To set something up is to establish it, and the locale of a novel or play is its backdrop.

clue.text: Young guns?

parts.note: read as brash newcomers, but taken literally as young male horses that share a name with a famous revolver maker

explanation.walkthrough: 'Young guns' sounds like ambitious newcomers; the answer is both young male horses and Colt revolvers, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Young stallions carry this name, and so do revolvers made by the Colt firearms company.

clue.text: Subsequently, a lovely start was made by the side

parts.note: subsequently means later, afterwards

indicators.note: the start of a word is its opening letter, here taken from lovely

explanation.surface: Later on, a fine beginning was made by the team on the sidelines.
explanation.definitionFit: Lateral describes something situated at or coming from the side, as in a lateral pass.

clue.text: Sheep wearing rug jacket

indicators.note: the rug is being worn by the sheep, so it wraps around them

parts.note: a mat is a small rug
female sheep are ewes

explanation.surface: Sheep are dressed in a rug, as if it were a coat.
explanation.walkthrough: A MAE WEST is an inflatable life jacket, named after the buxom film star by Second World War airmen.
explanation.definitionFit: An inflatable life vest worn by wartime aircrew got its nickname from a curvaceous Hollywood actress.

clue.text: Two ways in which forest have one means of advancement

indicators.note: the two ways surround the forest, which sits in between them

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
ST again, the second of the two streets
Epping Forest is an ancient woodland just north-east of London
taken as written

explanation.surface: A puzzling description of paths through a forest as a way to get ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in which' puts the forest between the two streets. Epping Forest is an ancient woodland on London's north-eastern edge; 'Two ways' stands for two separate STs.
explanation.definitionFit: A stone placed in a stream for crossing, figuratively a stage that helps someone progress.

clue.text: Perch is an antipodean creature with origins in southern Tasmania

parts.note: a roo is a kangaroo, an Australian animal

indicators.note: the origins of the words southern and Tasmania are their first letters

explanation.surface: A claim that the perch is a fish native to the far south of Australia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perch' looks like the fish in an Australian setting, but it is the place a bird settles.
explanation.definitionFit: A bird's resting place for the night is where it settles, a synonym for a perch.

clue.text: Revolutionary Iran, or ancient religious belief

indicators.note: revolutionary suggests overturning, so the letters of the three words are turned into a new order

explanation.surface: Is it post-revolution Iran or some old faith?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolutionary Iran' points at 1979 politics; the word is an anagram signal over IRAN OR ANCIENT.
explanation.definitionFit: The doctrine of rebirth into a new body after death is held by Hindus, Buddhists and others.

clue.text: Material from college article has bearing

parts.note: a poly is a polytechnic, a type of British college
the definite article is the
NE, north-east, is a compass bearing

explanation.surface: Some fabric comes from a college item with a particular direction.
explanation.definitionFit: A plastic used for bags and sheeting, a type of synthetic stuff.

clue.text: Delighted the borders of Portugal were relaxed

indicators.note: the borders of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: eased means loosened up or relaxed

explanation.surface: Someone is happy that Portugal's frontier controls were loosened.
explanation.definitionFit: Happy and glad, a near synonym of overjoyed.

clue.text: Tend to be caught between home and occupation

indicators.note: the caught letter sits between the words for home and occupation

parts.note: in means at home
a line is a line of work, an occupation
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: Someone is likely to be trapped between house and work.
explanation.definitionFit: To be inclined to do something is to have a tendency towards it.

clue.text: Dish that might be useful at university

parts.note: to serve is to be of use, as in it will serve
up means at university, as in up at Oxford

explanation.surface: A plate that could come in handy for a student.
explanation.definitionFit: To dish something out is to present food on plates for eating.

clue.text: Stick with cold fish

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on a tap
a ling is a long, slender sea fish

explanation.surface: Stay loyal to the chilled seafood.
explanation.definitionFit: To adhere or hold on tightly, as clothes do to wet skin.

clue.text: Incorrectly spelt? I'm no dope!

indicators.note: incorrectly suggests getting something wrong, so the letters of spelt, I'm and no are disordered

explanation.surface: A poor speller protests that they are not an idiot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Incorrectly spelt' reads as a complaint, but 'Incorrectly' rearranges SPELT IM NO.
explanation.definitionFit: A dope is a fool or nitwit, someone easily taken in.

clue.text: Curses motorway, giving wrong signal

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for motorway, as in M1

indicators.note: wrong suggests putting letters in the wrong order, so the letters of signal are shuffled

explanation.surface: A driver curses the motorway for its faulty signal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrong' looks like it describes the signal, but it is the anagram signal; the rearranged letters come after the M.
explanation.definitionFit: To speak ill of someone and slander them is to bad-mouth them, much like cursing.

clue.text: A good example, part poser

parts.note: a role is an actor's part
a model is someone who poses for an artist or photographer

explanation.surface: Someone sets a fine example by partly posing.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone whose behaviour others look up to and copy.

clue.text: One who yearns to accept university chair?

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so the yearner holds the university letter

parts.note: a longer is someone who longs or yearns

explanation.surface: A dreamer hopes to be appointed to a university professorship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'university chair' suggests a professorship; the chair is furniture to lounge in, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A comfortable reclining seat for relaxing, as by a pool, is a kind of seat.

clue.text: Where actors meet in a variety performance?

definitions.text: Where actors meet in a variety performance?

indicators.note: variety implies a mixture, so the letters of meet in a are mixed up

explanation.surface: Asking where performers come together in a music-hall show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variety' rearranges MEET IN A. The whole clue also hints at the answer: an afternoon show is where actors meet an audience.
explanation.definitionFit: An afternoon showing of a play or film is a daytime performance.

clue.text: Information from carbon found in polyunsaturates

indicators.note: the carbon is found inside the word for polyunsaturates

parts.note: polyunsaturates are a type of fats
C is the chemical symbol for carbon

explanation.surface: Data drawn from the carbon in healthy oils.
explanation.definitionFit: Data and details known to be true make up information.

clue.text: Support for an ingredient of successful crumpets

indicators.note: ingredient of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: What goes into successful crumpets, the base for tea.
explanation.definitionFit: The pivot point on which a lever rests is its support.

clue.text: National flag betrays embarrassment

definitions.meaning: blushes, turns red in the face

explanation.definitionFit: A regiment or nation's standard is its banner, and a person who reddens with shame blushes.

clue.text: Acquit a criminal surviving on water

indicators.note: criminal suggests something wrongly done, so the letters of acquit a are rearranged

explanation.surface: A court frees a lawbreaker who lives at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'criminal' looks like the person acquitted but it signals the rearrangement of ACQUIT A.
explanation.definitionFit: Animals and plants that live in or on water are described this way.

clue.text: Shed tears over working with a close friend

indicators.note: the tears are shed over the working, covering it on both sides

parts.note: to cry is to shed tears
on means working, as in the machine is on

explanation.surface: Someone weeps over a project shared with an old pal.
explanation.definitionFit: A crony is a close companion or chum.

clue.text: Old scientist, given one sign, chasing young lady

indicators.note: chasing means coming after, so the one and sign follow the young lady

parts.note: gal is an informal word for a girl
I is the Roman numeral for one
Leo is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: An elderly scientist, star-sign in hand, pursues a girl.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian astronomer who championed the idea that the Earth goes round the Sun.

clue.text: Naive but clever vowel swapping

indicators.note: one vowel is exchanged for another in the word for clever

parts.note: ingenious means clever and inventive

explanation.surface: Naive yet bright, someone swaps vowels.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vowel swapping' changes the second I of INGENIOUS into U.
explanation.definitionFit: Innocent and unsuspecting, unworldly to the point of naivety.

clue.text: Disturb game bird, blowing its head off

indicators.note: the head of the word for the game bird, its first letter, is removed

parts.note: a grouse is a game bird shot on moors

explanation.surface: Upsetting a game bird by shooting its head off.
explanation.definitionFit: To wake or stir someone up is to disturb them.

clue.text: Bursary for children's verse?

parts.note: read as a grant for writing poems for children, but the word bursary itself chimes with a place for small children

explanation.walkthrough: 'Bursary' rhymes with 'nursery', so the word itself is a rhyme for a nursery: the clue is a pun on the name for traditional children's songs.
explanation.definitionFit: Traditional songs and poems taught to small children, such as Humpty Dumpty.
